translations.web: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”
translations.bsb: Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers; say to my soul: “I am your salvation.”
translations.kjv: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
translations.asv: Draw out also the spear, and stop the way against them that pursue me: Say unto my soul, I am thy salvation.
